sentence_stem: My brother has an old bike, so
correct_completion: he rides it to school every day.
full_sentence: My brother has an old bike, so he rides it to school every day.
acceptable_variants: he uses it to get to work.
he takes it to the park.

options.why_wrong: This is unrelated information. 'So' needs a result that follows from owning the bike.

options.text: he rides it to school every day.

options.why_wrong: This contradicts the usual result of owning a bike and does not follow from 'so'.
This describes a skill that has no link to owning a bike.

grammar_focus: Result clauses with 'so' and the article 'an' before a vowel sound
explanation: After 'so', the clause must show a result of owning the bike. The article 'an' appears before 'old' because the next word begins with a vowel sound, not because of its spelling.
translation: У мого брата є старий велосипед, тому він їздить на ньому до школи щодня.
